exp.desc:
- Laptop rollout and user management
- Service desk for 80 staff
- Final project: new backup concept with restore tests

cl.p1: For my final apprenticeship project I rebuilt the backup strategy at an 80-person engineering firm: from a single NAS in the server room to a 3-2-1 setup with an encrypted offsite copy and monthly restore tests. The first test found a broken database backup.
cl.p2: I have rolled out laptops, managed users and groups, documented firewall rules and helped run the service desk. I manage Linux servers at work and at home, and I automate routine tasks with PowerShell and Bash.
cl.p3: At a utility, security is not optional, and I would like to learn how you separate office IT from operational systems. I can start in August.

cl.p1: For eight years at a managed service provider I have looked after other companies’ infrastructure without ever seeing what it is used for. I would like to work in-house again, for people I know.
cl.p2: I am responsible for around 200 virtual servers, several customers’ directories and their migration from on-premises mail to the cloud. Last year I coordinated recovery after a ransomware incident; since then I push offline backups and network segmentation wherever I can.
cl.p3: I am happy to join the on-call rota and can move after three months’ notice.
